This file carries out the data wrangling for my project.

It reads in files stored in `raw_data` and outputs files into `data` that are read by the `report.qmd` file.

Note that the files have a date stamp.
These should be updated when you make changes.

See the following example (which should be updated with more appropriate names and current dates).

```{r}
#| message: false
players2021 <- readr::read_csv("raw_data/players2022.csv") |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  mutate(games_per = gp/82) |>
  filter(gp > 21)
# other data wrangling goes here
players2020 <- readr::read_csv("raw_data/players2021.csv") |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  mutate(games_per = gp/56) |>
  filter(gp > 14)
players2019 <- readr::read_csv("raw_data/players2020.csv") |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  mutate(games_per = gp/71) |>
  filter(gp > 18)
players2018 <- readr::read_csv("raw_data/players2019.csv") |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  mutate(games_per = gp/82) |>
  filter(gp > 21)

allstars <- readr::read_csv("raw_data/allstars.csv") |>
  janitor::clean_names()

players <- players2021 |> 
  full_join(players2020) |> 
  full_join(players2019) |>
  full_join(players2018) |>
  distinct(player, pos, season, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(ppg = pts/gp,
         pspg = ps/gp,
         ppg10 = ppg*10,
         games_per10 = games_per*10) |>
  left_join(allstars) |>
  mutate(all_star_team = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(all_star_team), "No", "Yes")),
         s_per = ifelse(is.na(s_per), 0, s_per),
         pos_group = case_when(str_detect(pos,"C")==TRUE~"F",
                               str_detect(pos,"LW")==TRUE~"F",
                               str_detect(pos,"RW")==TRUE~"F",
                               str_detect(pos,"F")==TRUE~"F",
                               str_detect(pos,"W")==TRUE~"F",
                               TRUE~"D"))

players2022 <- readr::read_csv("raw_data/players2023.csv") |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  distinct(player, pos, season, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(ppg = pts/gp,
         pspg = ps/gp,
         ppg10 = ppg*10,
         games_per = gp/82,
         games_per10 = games_per*10,
         pos_group = case_when(str_detect(pos,"C")==TRUE~"F",
                               str_detect(pos,"LW")==TRUE~"F",
                               str_detect(pos,"RW")==TRUE~"F",
                               str_detect(pos,"F")==TRUE~"F",
                               str_detect(pos,"W")==TRUE~"F",
                               TRUE~"D")) |>
        filter(gp > 21)

save(players, players2022, file = "data/project-2023-05-02.RData")
rm(allstars, players, players2018, players2019, players2020, players2021, players2022)
```
